figures.caption: Figure 1: Architectural overview of ConvNeXt-FD. The encoder path utilizes ConvNeXt blocks for hierarchical feature extraction, followed by a bottleneck. The decoder path reconstructs the segmentation mask through upsampling and concatenation with skip connections from the encoder. The final output is optimized using a hybrid loss function incorporating a boundary-aware term.
